test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

In fits and starts
solution: The correct answer is **"Irregularly."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"in fits and starts" **means irregularly or intermittently. (अनियमित रूप से या रुक-रुक कर) • **Example**: *The economy was recovering **in fits and starts**__.* • It refers to something that happens in short bursts, with long pauses in between. • This phrase can be used to describe a person's behaviour, a project's progress, or even a machine's functioning. • The correct answer is Option 3. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (Everywhere) **means in or to every place. (सब जगह, सर्वत्र) • **Option 2 (Be in difficulty): **If you are in difficulty or in difficulty, you are having a lot of problems. (यदि आप कठिनाई में हैं या कठिनाइयों में हैं, तो आपको बहुत सारी समस्याएं हो रही हैं।) • **Option 4 (Summary)** is completely unrelated to the idiom. (किसी (अवतरण) का सार-संक्षेप) 19b:Tb9a, The correct answer is **"Gambit."**
